ORC-1.subject: instruction-change acceptability and any verdict without a higher-rung oracle
ORC-1.mechanism: principal review at the PR checkpoint; spec consensus with exported decisions where one exists

ORC-3.subject: every commit's shape: the [ORACLE] section and the Oracle trailer
ORC-3.mechanism: plugins/harness/hooks/commit-shape-gate.sh via PostToolUse on Bash; tested by tests/commit-shape-gate-test.sh

ORC-7.subject: the pushed stack's shape: no fixup!/squash!/amend! commit survives in the outgoing range
ORC-7.mechanism: plugins/harness/hooks/commit-shape-gate.sh push detector via PostToolUse on Bash; shares the gate and its kill switch with ORC-3; tested by tests/commit-shape-gate-test.sh
